title: Company Vision Week brief and 80-day sprint outline
content:
PURPOSE
This doc is the working brief for 'Vision Week' (internal week of alignment and execution reset) and a lightweight 80-day sprint outline and owner map. Primary audience: execs, product leads, eng managers, and comms owners. Use this as the source of truth for the all-hands run and follow-on OKR drafts.

TL;DR
- Host a 90-minute company kickoff (exec + product slate) on day 1 morning.
- Surface 3 company-level priorities for next 80 days (focus lanes) and cascade to functional OKR drafts.
- Run two focused breakouts: 1) Reliability & SLOs operational sprint; 2) Cost/perf optimization for hosted API.
- Communications: short exec note, FAQ, team-level shortbacks.

Context and constraints
- Q4 revenue targets and Dedicated contract ramp require predictable latency improvements and cost-per-token reduction.
- Private deployment enterprise customers expect clearer rollout timelines for VPC/on-prem features.
- Hiring constraints: limited senior infra headcount until Jan 2026.
- Timebox: product + eng owners have 3 business days post-vision-week to finalize team OKRs.

Company 80-day focus lanes (proposed)
1) Production economics: reduce avg token cost by 15% across hosted-api via batching, cache policy, and quantization profiles.
   - Measure: cost-per-1k-tokens by model family (baseline: Oct 2025).
   - Hypothesis: targeted KV caching + autoscaling tweaks reduce per-token GPU time for startup workloads.
   - Suggested owners: Priya Desai (Product) + Daniel Kim (Serving Runtime).

2) Reliability ramp: 99.9% latency SLO at 95th pct for interactive endpoints in primary region.
   - Measure: 95p latency and P99 error budget burn rate.
   - Mitigations: regional fallback policy, lower-burst auto-throttle, canary traffic shaping.
   - Owners: Oliver Reyes (SRE) + Maya Thompson (Product Ops).

3) Enterprise readiness: complete VPC onboarding docset + HSM/KMS playbook for two pilot accounts.
   - Measure: pilot completion checklist (network + compliance signoff).
   - Owners: Sarah Nguyen (Private Deployments) + Legal (TBD).

Draft company-level OKRs (working)
OKR 1: Improve inference unit economics
  - KR1.1: Reduce average hosted-api token cost by 15% (benchmark: Oct 2025).
  - KR1.2: Deploy caching profile experiment to 40% of traffic with no regression in quality metrics.
  - KR1.3: Identify and ship top-3 model quantization profiles for main customer workload.
OKR owner: Priya Desai

OKR 2: Reach operational SLOs for interactive services
  - KR2.1: 95th pct latency <= 200ms for L1 endpoints in primary region.
  - KR2.2: Reduce incident mean time to mitigate (MTTM) by 30% using runbooks + alert tuning.
  - KR2.3: Canary rollouts and automated fallback policies deployed to production.
OKR owner: Oliver Reyes

OKR 3: Enterprise deployment readiness and compliance
  - KR3.1: Complete on-prem packaging + install guide for pilot customers.
  - KR3.2: Document KMS/HSM integration and complete one successful audit trail test.
OKR owner: Sarah Nguyen

NOTE: Team-level OKR drafts will map into these lanes; product leads to submit final team OKRs by EOD Nov 19, 2025.

All-hands run of show (Day 1) — 90 minutes
00:00–00:05 — Org welcome and framing (CEO)
00:05–00:25 — State of the product & market: traction, usage trends, customer asks (Head of Product)
00:25–00:40 — Company priorities: introduction of the 3 focus lanes (Maya Thompson + Priya)
00:40–00:60 — Spotlight: Reliability & Performance playbook (Oliver Reyes)
00:60–00:80 — Breakouts announcement + logistics (group leads)
00:80–00:90 — Closing: next steps & sprint timelines (CEO)

Breakouts (Day 1 afternoon)
- Breakout A: Reliability SLOs and runbook sprint (SRE + Eng leads) — deliverables: runbook revisions, alert ownership, 2-week on-call play test.
- Breakout B: Cost & model serving optimizations (Applied ML + Serving Runtime) — deliverables: experiment plan for caching, batching, quant profiles.

Preparation checklist (owners)
- Exec slides: Maya (owner) — draft due Nov 10
- Product state deck: Priya — draft Nov 10
- Breakout readouts template: Daniel — draft Nov 11
- Comms FAQ & follow-up note: Comms (Kate Liu) — draft Nov 12
- Tech pre-reads (SRE + Runtime): Oliver, Daniel — publish Nov 12

Communications plan
1) Day 0 (internal email): CEO note + link to Vision Week pre-reads.
2) Day 1 (post all-hands): 1-pager recap + FAQ linked in team channels + Confluence.
3) Day 7: short pulse survey to capture concerns and blockers (ops cadence).
Key channels: #company-vision-week, comms mailing list, Confluence page linked above.

Risk register (working)
- Risk: Exec-level misalignment on top priority -> Mitigation: 30-min leadership pre-brief 48 hours before event (owner: Maya).
- Risk: Breakouts produce too many competing asks -> Mitigation: enforce 3 deliverables max per breakout, and triage through product-ops (Priya).
- Risk: Customer-facing feature timelines slip -> Mitigation: map explicit external commitments and set conservative release windows (owner: Sarah).

Decisions needed before run
- Confirm top 3 focus lanes (deadline: Nov 9).
- Finalize all-hands run-of-show and speaker list (deadline: Nov 10).
- Approve survey pulse + framing (deadline: Nov 12).

Action items (first pass)
- Priya: finalize OKR templates + distribute to leads (due Nov 12).
- Oliver: produce SLO draft and incident runbook updates (due Nov 14).
- Daniel: draft cost experiment matrix and baseline measurement queries (due Nov 14).
- Kate Liu (Comms): draft CEO lead note and post-all-hands recap (due Nov 12).
- Maya: coordinate executive pre-brief and finalize slate (due Nov 9).

Open questions and discussion points (notes to self)
- How do we weight cost vs latency in OKR scoring? (quality metrics tie-breaker?)
- Do we offer an explicit rollback SLA for customers if canary causes regressions?
- Should sales get an early readout for enterprise pilot timelines?

Appendix: quick links and refs
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/vision-week-prep
- Baseline dashboards: https://metrics.redwood/company/perf-2025-oct
- Infra tickets: JIRA-2142, JIRA-2190, JIRA-2215
- Example GH PR for rollout helper: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/678

Notes on tone and scope: keep the all-hands tight and execution-oriented. This doc is intentionally a working draft — expect edits after leadership pre-brief. Use bold callouts in slides for the one true metric per focus lane.
